title: "Dataset files"

---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
summary = FileAttachment("data/catalog_summary.json").json()
config = FileAttachment("data/site_config.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Served from site/vendor/ (see vendor/vendor.yml) instead of jsDelivr, which
// Quarto's OJS runtime would otherwise use for the `html` builtin.
vendor = (p) => new URL(`vendor/${p}`, document.baseURI).href
htl = require(vendor("htl/htl.min.js"))
html = htl.html
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// The dataset comes from the page URL: dataset.html?id=<dataset_id>.
id = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("id") ?? ""
row = summary.find((d) => d.dataset_id === id) ?? null
// File names come from the same file-list shard the Browse page uses.
files = row
  ? ((await (await fetch(`data/${row.file_list}`)).json())[id] ?? [])
  : []
// Citation and licence per non-CMIP6 product (summarize_catalog.py --products).
// Optional: an older build without products.json shows no citation block.
products = await fetch("data/products.json").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : {})).catch(() => ({}))
product = row?.product ? (products[row.product] ?? null) : null
urls = files.map((f) => `${config.https_prefix}/${row.relative_path}/${f}`)
isPlaceholder = (v) => !v || /_TBD$/.test(v)
internal = config.audience === "internal"
reportUrl = (d) => {
  const u = new URL(`https://github.com/${config.github_repo}/issues/new`);
  u.searchParams.set("template", "report-problem.yml");
  u.searchParams.set("title", `[Problem]: ${d.dataset_id}`);
  u.searchParams.set("dataset_id", d.dataset_id);
  u.searchParams.set("path", d.relative_path);
  return u.href;
}
copyBlock = (text, lang = "") => {
  const pre = html`<pre class="sourceCode ${lang}"><code>${text}</code></pre>`;
  const btn = html`<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary mb-2">Copy</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
    btn.textContent = "Copied";
    setTimeout(() => (btn.textContent = "Copy"), 1500);
  });
  return html`<div class="get-data-block">${btn}${pre}</div>`;
}
facetLabels = [
  ["collection", "Collection"],
  ["product", "Product"],
  ["frequency", "Frequency"],
  ["level", "Level"],
  ["activity_id", "Activity"],
  ["institution_id", "Institution"],
  ["source_id", "Source (model)"],
  ["experiment_id", "Experiment"],
  ["member_id", "Member"],
  ["table_id", "Table"],
  ["variable_id", "Variable"],
  ["grid_label", "Grid"],
  ["version", "Version"]
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
row === null
  ? html`<div class="alert alert-warning">
      ${id ? html`No dataset <code>${id}</code> in catalog <strong>${config.catalog_version}</strong>.`
           : "No dataset given."}
      Find one on the <a href="browse.html">Browse</a> page.</div>`
  : html`<p class="mb-1"><a href="browse.html">← Browse datasets</a></p>
    <h2 class="mt-2"><code style="white-space: normal; word-break: break-all;">${row.dataset_id}</code></h2>
    <table class="table table-sm w-auto small mb-3"><tbody>
      ${facetLabels.filter(([k]) => row[k] != null).map(([k, label]) =>
        html`<tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">${label}</th><td>${row[k]}</td></tr>`)}
      <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Time range</th><td>${row.time_start == null && row.time_end == null ? "—" : `${row.time_start ?? "?"} to ${row.time_end ?? "?"}`}</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Size</th><td>${row.n_files.toLocaleString()} files,
        ${row.size_gb.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 1})} GB</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Catalog</th><td>${config.catalog_version}</td></tr>
    </tbody></table>
    <p><a href="${reportUrl(row)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Report a problem with this dataset</a></p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
product === null
  ? html`<span></span>`
  : html`<h3>Cite this product</h3>
    ${product.description ? html`<p>${product.description}</p>` : ""}
    <table class="table table-sm w-auto small mb-3"><tbody>
      <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Citation</th><td>${product.citation ?? html`<em>not recorded yet</em>`}</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">License</th><td>${product.license ?? html`<em>not recorded yet</em>`}</td></tr>
      ${product.acknowledgment
        ? html`<tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Acknowledgment</th><td>${product.acknowledgment}</td></tr>`
        : ""}
    </tbody></table>
    <p class="small">See also <a href="cite.html">How to cite</a>.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
row === null
  ? html`<span></span>`
  : html`<h3>Files</h3>
    ${isPlaceholder(config.https_prefix)
      ? html`<p><em>HTTPS downloads are not available yet; the URL prefix in these links is a placeholder.</em></p>`
      : ""}
    ${files.length !== row.n_files
      ? html`<p><em>The file list has ${files.length} of the catalog's ${row.n_files} files.</em></p>`
      : ""}
    <ol class="dataset-files small">
      ${urls.map((u, i) => html`<li><a href="${u}" download>${files[i]}</a></li>`)}
    </ol>
    <p>To fetch them all, save <code>urls.txt</code> and run the command below
    (see the <a href="download-guide.html">download guide</a>).</p>
    <p>${DOM.download(new Blob([urls.join("\n") + "\n"], {type: "text/plain"}), "urls.txt", "Download urls.txt")}</p>
    ${copyBlock("wget --continue --force-directories --no-host-directories -i urls.txt", "bash")}
    ${internal
      ? html`<h3>On VAST</h3>
        ${copyBlock(`${config.vast_prefix}/${row.relative_path}/`)}
        <p>On HPC this path works as shown. Over the SMB share, see the
        <a href="access.html">access page</a> for the share name.</p>`
      : ""}`
```
